message:
Document/PDF support: pick a photo or PDF; packages/ai accepts application/pdf

Add expo-document-picker so the Update Medical Files screen can select a PDF
(expo-image-picker cannot), normalize both pickers into a PickedFile, and widen
the Claude vision extractor (DocumentExtractor.extractFromImage ->
extractFromDocument) + /api/extract-document to accept application/pdf alongside
image/jpeg|png|gif|webp. This is the pair of prerequisites Schmidt's upload
redesign flagged as needed before offering PDF.
